title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on 1 Chronicles chapter 26 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of 1 Chronicles Chapter 26.

questions.question: Who was Meshelemiah in 1 Chronicles 26?
options: Son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph
questions.correctAnswer: Son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:1 identifies Meshelemiah as the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

questions.question: Who was the firstborn son of Meshelemiah?
questions.correctAnswer: Zechariah
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:2 states Zechariah as the firstborn son of Meshelemiah.

questions.question: Which son was the sixth of Meshelemiah?
questions.correctAnswer: Jehohanan
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:3 lists Jehohanan as the sixth son of Meshelemiah.

questions.question: How many sons did Obededom have?
questions.correctAnswer: Eight
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:5 states that Obededom had eight sons.

questions.question: What was said about Obededom in 1 Chronicles 26?
questions.correctAnswer: God blessed him
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:5 specifically says 'for God blessed him' referring to Obededom.

questions.question: True or False: The sons of Shemaiah were mighty men of valour.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:6 explains that Shemaiah's sons were mighty men of valour.

questions.question: Who was the chief son of Hosah, though not the firstborn?
questions.correctAnswer: Simri
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:10 states that Simri was made chief by his father despite not being the firstborn.

questions.question: How many sons and brethren did Hosah have?
questions.correctAnswer: Thirteen
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:11 says all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

questions.question: True or False: Meshelemiah had eighteen strong men among his sons and brethren.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:9 records that Meshelemiah had eighteen strong men among his sons and brethren.

questions.question: Which of these sons was NOT listed as one of Obededom's sons in 1 Chronicles 26?
questions.correctAnswer: Jediael
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:4 lists Jehozabad, Sacar, and Nethaneel as sons of Obededom, but Jediael is a son of Meshelemiah (1 Chronicles 26:2).

questions.question: True or False: Jehohanan was the fourth son of Meshelemiah.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:3 shows Jehohanan as the sixth son; Jathniel was the fourth son.

questions.question: Which of these was a son of Shemaiah?
questions.correctAnswer: Othni
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:7 lists Othni as one of the sons of Shemaiah.

questions.question: In the divisions of the porters, who cast lots for the gates?
options: Both the small and the great
questions.correctAnswer: Both the small and the great
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:13 states that both the small and the great cast lots according to the house of their fathers for every gate.

questions.question: Who had the lot eastward according to 1 Chronicles 26?
questions.correctAnswer: Shelemiah
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:14 says the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah.

questions.question: According to the chapter, which group was assigned the gate Shallecheth?
questions.correctAnswer: Shuppim and Hosah
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:16 indicates that the lot came forth westward to Shuppim and Hosah with the gate Shallecheth.

medium.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 26:12-13, how were the porter divisions assigned their duties in the house of the LORD?
options: They were assigned by family heritage and casting lots
They volunteered for their favorite gates
King David personally appointed each porter
They were assigned based on age and strength
questions.correctAnswer: They were assigned by family heritage and casting lots
questions.explanation: Verses 12 and 13 explain that the divisions were among chief men with wards one against another to minister in the house of the LORD, and they cast lots according to the house of their fathers for each gate.

questions.question: What role did Shelemiah and his son Zechariah play in the porter divisions, according to verses 14?
options: Shelemiah got the eastward lot and Zechariah the northward
Shelemiah led the south gate and Zechariah the west gate
They were responsible for the treasury
questions.correctAnswer: Shelemiah got the eastward lot and Zechariah the northward
questions.explanation: Verse 14 states that the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah, and for his son Zechariah, a wise counsellor, the lot came out northward.

questions.question: Based on 1 Chronicles 26:15, what responsibility was given to Obededom and his sons?
options: They were assigned the house of Asuppim
They served as officers in Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They were assigned the house of Asuppim
questions.explanation: Verse 15 specifies that Obededom was assigned southward, and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 26:16 teach about the allocation of the westward gate duties?
options: The lot came to Shuppim and Hosah with the gate Shallecheth
The westward gate was left unassigned
Only priests were allowed at the westward gate
The gate was guarded by David’s personal guards
questions.correctAnswer: The lot came to Shuppim and Hosah with the gate Shallecheth
questions.explanation: Verse 16 reveals that the lot for the westward gate came to Shuppim and Hosah, guarding the gate Shallecheth by the causeway of the going up.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 26:17, how were the Levites distributed around the gates?
options: Six eastward, four northward, four southward, and two by Asuppim
All Levites were stationed at the east gate
Twelve Levites guarded the treasury only
Levites guarded only the southern gates
questions.correctAnswer: Six eastward, four northward, four southward, and two by Asuppim
questions.explanation: Verse 17 details the distribution of Levites: six eastward, four northward, four southward, and two and two toward Asuppim.

questions.question: What additional detail does 1 Chronicles 26:18 provide about the porter divisions at Parbar?
options: Four were at the causeway and two at Parbar
Parbar was guarded only at night
Parbar was a treasury area with no porters
questions.correctAnswer: Four were at the causeway and two at Parbar
questions.explanation: Verse 18 states that at Parbar westward, four were at the causeway and two at Parbar itself.

questions.question: How does 1 Chronicles 26:19 summarize the porter divisions described in the earlier verses?
options: They were among the sons of Kore and the sons of Merari
They were assigned based on wealth
They were all descendants of Moses
They were appointed by King Saul
questions.correctAnswer: They were among the sons of Kore and the sons of Merari
questions.explanation: Verse 19 summarizes that these porter divisions were among the sons of Kore and among the sons of Merari.

questions.question: What responsibility did Ahijah have among the Levites as per 1 Chronicles 26:20?
options: He was over the treasures of the house of God and dedicated things
He led the porter divisions at the east gate
He was a chief officer over Israel’s army
He was a scribe recording genealogies
questions.correctAnswer: He was over the treasures of the house of God and dedicated things
questions.explanation: Verse 20 clearly states that Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God and the treasures of the dedicated things.

questions.question: Who were Jehieli and his sons, according to 1 Chronicles 26:21-22?
options: Chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite and overseers of the house’s treasures
Leaders of the Merarite porter divisions
questions.correctAnswer: Chief fathers of Laadan the Gershonite and overseers of the house’s treasures
questions.explanation: Verses 21 and 22 describe Jehieli as chief father of Laadan the Gershonite, and his sons, Zetham and Joel, who were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.

questions.question: What practical lesson about trust and organization in service does 1 Chronicles 26:12-19 teach?
options: Faithful service requires orderly division of duties and reliance on God’s guidance through casting lots
Only the strongest should serve in ministry roles
Leadership positions are inherited without accountability
Service is best when randomly assigned without planning
questions.correctAnswer: Faithful service requires orderly division of duties and reliance on God’s guidance through casting lots
questions.explanation: Verses 12-19 emphasize organized porter divisions assigned by lots according to family, showing trust in God’s guidance and the importance of order in service.

questions.question: A believer struggles with feeling unworthy for ministry. Based on 1 Chronicles 26:13-14, what biblical truth can encourage them?
options: God assigns roles according to His wisdom and family heritage, not just personal merit
Only the most skilled serve God
Ministry is reserved for the oldest in the family
questions.correctAnswer: God assigns roles according to His wisdom and family heritage, not just personal merit
questions.explanation: Verses 13-14 show that casting lots assigned porter duties according to family, illustrating God’s sovereign choice rather than human merit alone.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 26:15-16, the sons of Obededom were assigned to guard the eastern gate.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 15 states Obededom was assigned southward and his sons the house of Asuppim; verse 16 assigns the eastward gate to Shelemiah, not Obededom.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 26:17-18 describes a careful balance of Levite porter guards stationed at different gates and locations.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verses 17-18 detail the exact number of Levites stationed eastward, northward, southward, toward Asuppim, and at Parbar, showing balanced assignments.

questions.question: True or False: 1 Chronicles 26:19-20 states that the sons of Merari were responsible for the treasures of the house of God.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 19 mentions the sons of Kore and Merari as porter divisions, but verse 20 assigns Ahijah, a Levite, to the treasures, not specifically the sons of Merari.

questions.question: How does the passage 1 Chronicles 26:21-22 teach about integrity in managing God’s resources?
options: Jehieli’s family was entrusted with the treasures, emphasizing responsible stewardship
They hid the treasures from the people
The treasures were managed by the king alone
Only priests could handle the treasures
questions.correctAnswer: Jehieli’s family was entrusted with the treasures, emphasizing responsible stewardship
questions.explanation: Verses 21-22 highlight Jehieli and his sons managing the house’s treasures, showing the importance of integrity and trustworthy stewardship.

hard.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from 1 Chronicles Chapter 26.

questions.question: Who was the ruler of the treasures of the house of God according to 1 Chronicles 26?
questions.correctAnswer: Shebuel the son of Gershom
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:24 states that Shebuel the son of Gershom, who was the son of Moses, was the ruler of the treasures of the house of God.

questions.question: What was the source of the dedicated things maintained by Shelomith and his brethren?
questions.correctAnswer: Spoils won in battles
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 26:27 explains that the dedicated things were from the spoils won in battles, which were used to maintain the house of the LORD.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 26, whose dedication was under the hand of Shelomith and his brethren?
options: Samuel the seer, Saul, Abner, and Joab
David the king and Nathan the prophet
questions.correctAnswer: Samuel the seer, Saul, Abner, and Joab
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 26:28 states that all that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated was under the hand of Shelomith and his brethren.

questions.question: What role did Chenaniah and his sons have among the Izharites?
options: Over the outward business of Israel, for officers and judges
Rulers of the treasures of the house of God
Chief priests in charge of sacrifices
questions.correctAnswer: Over the outward business of Israel, for officers and judges
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:29 describes Chenaniah and his sons as overseeing the outward business of Israel, serving as officers and judges among the Izharites.

questions.question: How many men of valour were among the Hebronites under Hashabiah and his brethren?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 26:30 reveals that Hashabiah and his brethren had 1,700 men of valour among the Hebronites, who were officers in Israel.

questions.question: In what year of King David's reign were mighty men of valour found among the Hebronites at Jazer of Gilead?
questions.correctAnswer: The fortieth year
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 26:31, in the fortieth year of David's reign, mighty men of valour were found among the Hebronites at Jazer of Gilead.

questions.question: Who did King David make rulers over the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh?
options: Jerijah and his brethren, men of valour
questions.correctAnswer: Jerijah and his brethren, men of valour
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 26:32 states that King David appointed Jerijah and his brethren, men of valour, as rulers over these tribes for matters pertaining to God and the king.

questions.question: The Hebrew term for 'treasures' used in this chapter primarily refers to what type of items?
options: Dedicated holy items and valuables for the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Dedicated holy items and valuables for the temple
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for 'treasures' (אוצר 'otsar') in this context refers to the dedicated valuables and holy items stored for the temple's use, as seen in 1 Chronicles 26:24-26 and cross-referenced with Exodus 36:3 which describes the storing of holy articles.

questions.question: Which literary device is evident in the listing of families and their roles in 1 Chronicles 26, emphasizing order and divine appointment?
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio
questions.explanation: The chapter uses inclusio by framing the duties of porters and treasure keepers with genealogical lists and assignments, highlighting order and divine appointment, as seen throughout verses 20-32. This device brackets the theme of temple service.

questions.question: What cross-biblical passage also emphasizes the role of Levites as gatekeepers and officers, similar to 1 Chronicles 26?
questions.correctAnswer: Nehemiah 12:25
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 12:25 also discusses the divisions of the gatekeepers among the Levites, paralleling the detailed records in 1 Chronicles 26 about porter duties and temple service.

questions.question: How does the role of Shebuel, son of Gershom, connect typologically to Moses in the context of temple treasury management?
options: As Moses' grandson, Shebuel symbolizes the continuation of divine stewardship over holy things
Shebuel was a priest like Moses
Shebuel replaced Moses as leader of Israel
Shebuel was unrelated to Moses' duties
questions.correctAnswer: As Moses' grandson, Shebuel symbolizes the continuation of divine stewardship over holy things
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:24 identifies Shebuel as the son of Gershom, Moses' son, linking him typologically to Moses and illustrating the continuation of God’s appointed stewardship over sacred treasures.

questions.question: True or False: According to 1 Chronicles 26, the sons of Laadan were responsible for guarding the treasures of the house of the LORD.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:21-22 states that the sons of Laadan, specifically Jehieli and his sons, were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.

questions.question: True or False: The chapter indicates that the lot for the eastward gate was given to Obededom.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: According to 1 Chronicles 26:14-15, the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah, not Obededom. Obededom's lot was southward.

questions.question: Which group in 1 Chronicles 26 were described as 'men of valour' numbering 2,700 and appointed by King David?
options: Brethren of Jerijah among the Hebronites
questions.correctAnswer: Brethren of Jerijah among the Hebronites
questions.explanation: Verse 1 Chronicles 26:32 notes that Jerijah’s brethren, men of valour numbering 2,700, were made rulers over certain tribes by King David.

questions.question: According to 1 Chronicles 26, what was the significance of casting lots among the porters?
options: To assign gate duties fairly among families
To determine who would become priests
To decide who would lead Israel in battle
To divide the spoils of war
questions.correctAnswer: To assign gate duties fairly among families
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 26:13 explains that lots were cast to assign wards at the gates among the porters from different families, ensuring fair distribution of duties.

theological.title: 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from 1 Chronicles Chapter 26 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 26:5 reveal about God's role in blessing individuals?
options: God blesses those who serve faithfully
God blesses the firstborn sons exclusively
questions.correctAnswer: God blesses those who serve faithfully
questions.explanation: Verse 5 states 'for God blessed him' in reference to Obededom and his sons, indicating God's blessing on faithful service and dedication.

questions.question: Which doctrine is illustrated by the detailed organization and casting of lots among the porters in 1 Chronicles 26:12-13?
options: God's sovereign providence over order and service
questions.correctAnswer: God's sovereign providence over order and service
questions.explanation: Verses 12 and 13 describe casting lots for gate assignments, illustrating God's sovereign guidance and providence in organizing His temple service.

questions.question: How do the divisions of the porters in 1 Chronicles 26 reflect the biblical theme of sanctification?
options: By setting apart individuals for dedicated service to God
By promoting the most powerful only
questions.correctAnswer: By setting apart individuals for dedicated service to God
questions.explanation: The chapter details how Levites were set apart and organized for temple service (verses 1-19), reflecting sanctification as being set apart for God's holy work.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is highlighted by God's blessing on Obededom's family as described in 1 Chronicles 26:6-8?
questions.correctAnswer: Grace
questions.explanation: The text shows God blessing Obededom's family with strength and valor (verses 6-8), demonstrating God's grace in empowering His servants beyond their natural ability.

questions.question: What theological insight emerges from combining 1 Chronicles 26:20 and 26:24 about stewardship in God's house?
options: God appoints trustworthy leaders to guard sacred treasures
All possessions belong to the king alone
Material wealth is not important in worship
Only priests may handle temple treasures
questions.correctAnswer: God appoints trustworthy leaders to guard sacred treasures
questions.explanation: Verse 20 describes Ahijah over the treasures, and verse 24 names Shebuel ruler of treasures, showing God’s provision of responsible stewardship for sacred things.

questions.question: Which doctrinal theme is emphasized by the dedication of spoils and treasures to the LORD’s house in 1 Chronicles 26:26-27?
options: The doctrine of offering and dedication
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of offering and dedication
questions.explanation: Verses 26-27 explain that spoils from battles were dedicated to maintain the temple, emphasizing the biblical doctrine that all things belong to God and are to be offered back to Him.

questions.question: How does the leadership of Jerijah among the Hebronites in 1 Chronicles 26:31-32 connect to the broader redemptive narrative?
options: Illustrates God's provision of strong, faithful leaders for His people
Shows the failure of Israel's leadership
questions.correctAnswer: Illustrates God's provision of strong, faithful leaders for His people
questions.explanation: Verses 31-32 describe mighty men made rulers by David, highlighting God’s ongoing preparation of leadership to guide His covenant people, a theme throughout redemptive history.

questions.question: What does 1 Chronicles 26:29 teach about God’s justice and governance over Israel?
options: God appoints officers and judges to administer justice
Only priests have authority over Israel
questions.correctAnswer: God appoints officers and judges to administer justice
questions.explanation: Verse 29 states Chenaniah and his sons were over officers and judges, showing God’s establishment of a just governance system in Israel.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the detailed divisions of gatekeepers in 1 Chronicles 26 are merely administrative and have no spiritual significance. What does 1 Chronicles 26:1-19 actually teach about their role?
options: Their service reflects sacred stewardship ordained by God for temple holiness
They were merely guards with no connection to worship
They were political appointees unrelated to God’s purposes
questions.correctAnswer: Their service reflects sacred stewardship ordained by God for temple holiness
questions.explanation: Verses 1-19 show careful organization of porters to guard and minister in the temple, indicating their role was divinely instituted and part of God’s holy order (cf. Exodus 28:43).

questions.question: What combined doctrinal teaching is presented by 1 Chronicles 26:9 and 26:11 about leadership and authority in God's house?
options: Leadership is given based on God's selection, not birth order
Only the strongest physically can lead
Leaders are chosen by popular vote
questions.correctAnswer: Leadership is given based on God's selection, not birth order
questions.explanation: Verse 9 notes strong men among Meshelemiah's sons, and verse 10 explains Hosah made his non-firstborn son chief, showing God’s sovereign choice in leadership.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by His appointment of Ahijah over the treasures of the house of God in 1 Chronicles 26:20?
questions.correctAnswer: God's wisdom in orderly management
questions.explanation: Verse 20 shows God’s provision for wise stewardship in His temple’s treasures, reflecting His attribute of divine wisdom in governance.

questions.question: How does the service of the Levites in 1 Chronicles 26:17-18 reflect the theme of divine order in worship?
options: Their roles were precisely assigned by wards, showing God’s ordered worship
Their service was voluntary and unorganized
questions.correctAnswer: Their roles were precisely assigned by wards, showing God’s ordered worship
questions.explanation: Verses 17-18 describe specific numbers assigned to gates and wards, demonstrating God’s design for orderly worship and service.

questions.question: What theological implication arises from the fact that the sons of Laadan and Jehieli were appointed over the treasures of the house of the LORD in 1 Chronicles 26:21-22?
options: God entrusts sacred responsibilities to faithful families, emphasizing covenant continuity
Treasures were not important in worship
Treasure management was a secular task
questions.correctAnswer: God entrusts sacred responsibilities to faithful families, emphasizing covenant continuity
questions.explanation: Assigning treasure oversight to Laadan’s descendants highlights God’s covenantal faithfulness in preserving holy duties within faithful lineages.

questions.question: What does the casting of lots for gate assignments (1 Chronicles 26:13-16) teach about God's justice and impartiality?
options: God ensures an unbiased and fair distribution of duties
God favors the greatest and strongest only
Only the firstborn received the best duties
questions.correctAnswer: God ensures an unbiased and fair distribution of duties
questions.explanation: Verses 13-16 describe casting lots equally among small and great, showing God’s just and impartial assignment of tasks.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal truth is taught by 1 Chronicles 26:28 and 1 Chronicles 26:26 regarding dedication of spoils and treasures?
options: All offerings and dedications to God must be carefully administered and accounted for
questions.correctAnswer: All offerings and dedications to God must be carefully administered and accounted for
questions.explanation: Verse 26 speaks of dedicated spoils, and verse 28 explains that all dedications were under Shelomith’s oversight, showing God’s requirement for proper stewardship.
